content:
Open-ended questions require respondents to formulate their own answers, which can lead to varied, non-standardized responses. This makes it harder to categorize, quantify, or systematically analyze the data compared to closed-ended questions.  

The difficulty is not primarily in getting people to fill out the survey (A), nor in collecting data quickly (C), nor in credibility of results (D), but in interpreting the qualitative answers consistently.  

Final answer: (B)
